answers.core: I suspect it would be much, much easier to implement this feature through the core than through an add-on given that MeshInstance3D already has a Surface Material Override feature; it simply needs to be propagated over to the MultiMeshInstasnce3D object.
answers.workaround: It can be, but requires using a Local to Scene mesh and overriding its material slots directly. It's not that what I need to do can't presently be done, it's just not as optimized as it could be with this proposed feature.

title: Add "Surface Material Override" Property to MultiMeshInstance3D
